rules.title: PR description
rules.description: Block pull requests without a useful body (minimum length and required headings).

rules.title: PR diff size
rules.description: Block oversized PRs during coding so agents split work across multiple pull requests.

rules.title: Proposal markdown only
rules.description: Self-improvement propose_change calls may only ship .md files — never build logs, caches, or other job artefacts.

rules.title: Merge requires approval
rules.description: Block scm_merge_pr until the PR has at least one human approval (verified via SCM status).
